senses.definition: a Benjamite, one of the murderers of Ishbosheth 2 S 4:2, 5, 6, 9.
father of one of David’s heroes 2 S 23:29 = 1 Ch 11:30.
head of a family of returning exiles Ezr 2:2 = Ne 7:7; perhaps also = בַּעֲנָא Ne 3:4
a chief of the people Ne 10:28.
